sparkov.display_name: Credit Card Transactions Fraud Detection Dataset
sparkov.license: CC0: Public Domain (Kaggle dataset card, retrieved 2026-09-16)
sparkov.citation: Kartik Shenoy, Credit Card Transactions Fraud Detection Dataset, Kaggle, 2020. Generated with Sparkov Data Generation (Brandon Harris, MIT).
sparkov.label_definition: 1 = transaction labelled fraudulent by the Sparkov generator that produced it
sparkov.notes: External synthetic benchmark. Simulated transactions for 1 Jan 2019 - 31 Dec 2020. Kaggle's description advertises 1000 cards and 800 merchants; the published files hold 999 cards and 693 merchant names. Not real card-transaction data.

ulb.license: DbCL-1.0: Database Contents License v1.0 (Kaggle dataset API, retrieved 2026-09-18)
ulb.citation: Machine Learning Group, Université Libre de Bruxelles, Credit Card Fraud Detection, Kaggle; collected in a research collaboration with Worldline. The dataset page asks that Dal Pozzolo, Caelen, Johnson and Bontempi, Calibrating Probability with Undersampling for Unbalanced Classification, IEEE CIDM 2015, and the further works it lists be cited.
ulb.label_definition: 1 = fraud, 0 = otherwise, as the dataset description defines Class
ulb.notes: Real, anonymised benchmark. The publisher describes transactions made by European cardholders over two days in September 2013: 492 frauds out of 284,807 transactions, advertised rather than observed. V1-V28 are PCA components of undisclosed inputs; Time is seconds since the first transaction; no currency is stated for Amount. Used on its own track only and never promoted: docs/adr/PHASE_5E_ULB_BENCHMARK_METHODOLOGY.md.
